Hero_Desc_Risty:
An unemployed layabout from Monatium, a pro-gamer, and a self-proclaimed hacker.
Once a listless slacker, but after a series of events, she has gained confidence ever since learning about hacking.
Skeptical of the typical elven treachery, it turns out she's unexpectedly kind-hearted.
Album_Like_Risty: League of Elves, a co-op game.
Album_Hate_Risty: League of Elves, a co-op game.
Album_Wish_Risty: Meeting a perfectly synchronized team in queue.
Album_Risty1: Other elves think Risty is a weird loner who plays games at home all day. Risty insists that if an online gaming tournament were held, she could be recognized, but Monatium only has local arcade events.
Album_Risty2: Risty sometimes makes bizarre claims about being able to hack reality. I thought she was just bluffing, so I told her to stop lying. She got really worked up and sulked in frustration.
Album_Risty3: Risty basically lives like a hardcore gamer. She survives off Monatium's welfare subsidies and spends all day gaming in a tiny room. I worry about her health... but since this is Elias, does it even matter?
Album_Risty4: Risty is active on the hidden "darknet" of Monatium's intranet, where she enjoys reading novels uploaded by anonymous users. She says the content can be pretty cringeworthy, but once you get used to it, it's oddly entertaining... For some reason, I have no desire to find out what kind of stories she's reading.
Album_Risty5: Risty once claimed she almost got arrested for illegal hacking. I assumed she was just bragging, but when I checked with Amelia later, she was visibly shaken. When I asked how much she knew about it, her pupils darted around in a panic.
Album_Risty6: Risty loves a drink called "Dr. Peppa" which is sold at Monatium's convenience stores. Most elves hate its distinct taste, so it's always stuck as an unsold item—Risty, however, buys one every day without fail.
Album_Risty7: Risty confidently declared that she could prove her reality-hacking abilities. She claimed her stuffed toy contained highly advanced AI technology that allowed her to reverse-engineer reality itself. To my surprise, she actually materialized a floating cube in the air, making her words suddenly believable. However... I still don't understand why her AI-powered doll is named "Glove".

LoveLetter_Risty: O/ O7! Sup, Master! I would've just sent you a message through the in-game chat, but you don't hop into my games very often, so I'm writing this as a letter instead. It's nothing big. Just wanted to say thanks for cleaning my room that one time and taking care of me at the Banquet Hall. But going all the way to see you for real is way too far and too much of a hassle, so a letter it is. That's okay, right? Come online more often from now on. Let's get into a match together. I'll carry you! Promise! Got it? That's a promise!
LoveCall_Risty:
Hello, Master? Busy right now? No, I just thought of you while I was playing a game.
Remember when we said we would queue as a duo?
The truth is, I raised my rank a little over the past few days...
So I do not think our tiers are a very good match anymore. Puhihit!
Ah, wait, wait! Think carefully before you get angry. Would it not be wiser to start working hard on your own rank today instead of getting mad at me?
If it is too difficult, I can coach you from beside you. How about it? You like that idea too, right?
So do not be angry. Let us just enjoy a game together!

Oh, that reminds me. I also bought a new multiplayer game that just came out!
Come visit my house when you have time!
I have no one to play it with, so it has been sitting there gathering dust.
And do not forget to bring something tasty that we can eat while playing! Understood?
I will see you next time, Master!
